included_categories.description: SUT application event with explicit ERROR or FATAL severity. Error messages remain available through canonical error.message.
SUT application warning with explicit WARN severity, excluding recognized runtime and lifecycle noise.
Recognized SUT operation/request event from the fixed, fault-independent application event patterns in contract.py.

excluded_categories.description: Explicit successful transaction-completion event already represented by request metrics and canonical trace outcome. This is a narrow event-class rule, not a blanket success-log filter.
Explicit health check/probe or checking a named service health event.
Known language runtime, framework, SDK, or platform diagnostic noise.
Known process/container/datastore startup, shutdown, persistence, and lifecycle output.
No explicit application severity or recognized application diagnostic pattern; retained in RAW and excluded by default.
